title: Recording Local Speech
transcript:
I tried asking my neighbour to read from a word list, and her vowels sounded different once we started chatting.
That makes sense. Reading is handy when you want everyone to say the same words, but people may pronounce them more carefully.
What if we use photographs to get people talking about places they remember? That worked with my neighbour.
I'd try that. We should also ask each person to bring a friend, since they may speak more freely with someone familiar.
Where should we record? The library offered us a room, though there's a ventilation fan.
I'd still take it. In my café recording, cups hitting saucers covered several words completely.
Fine. We could do a short trial there before inviting the rest of the group.
Let's listen to the trial together and check whether we can tell the two voices apart before we book more sessions.

questions.prompt: In the initial recording, the neighbour read from a word ____.
questions.explanation: 学生先请邻居朗读一份词表，再留意她在闲聊时的发音。

questions.prompt: The students plan to use ____ to prompt memories of local places.
questions.explanation: 学生提议用照片引导参与者谈论记忆中的地方。

questions.prompt: Each participant will be asked to bring a ____ to the session.
questions.explanation: 学生建议每位参与者带一位朋友，以便和熟悉的人更自然地交谈。

questions.prompt: What made some speech inaudible in the café recording?
options: A conversation at the next table
The sound of crockery knocking together
questions.answer: The sound of crockery knocking together
questions.explanation: 学生说杯子碰到杯碟的声音完全盖住了几个词。

questions.prompt: What will the students check when they listen to the trial recording?
options: Whether they can distinguish the speakers
Whether each speaker talks for the same length of time
Whether each speaker uses the expected local expressions
questions.answer: Whether they can distinguish the speakers
questions.explanation: 学生决定先听试录，确认能否分辨两个人的声音。
